items.title: Disney’s environmental sustainability co-lead leaves company
items.summary: Yalmaz Siddiqui has exited his role as vice president of environmental sustainability at The Walt Disney as a result of a corporate reorganization, effective Oct. 17.

items.title: TODAY: The future cost of EV charging – what businesses can’t afford to overlook
items.summary: Join edie on 22 October for our 45-minute masterclass, 'The Future Cost of EV Charging,' delivered in partnership with Brook Green Supply.

items.title: ‘Another wrong signal’: Jackdaw approval draws widespread criticism from green economy
items.summary: The UK Government’s approval of the controversial Jackdaw gas project has drawn significant criticism from across the green economy, reigniting concerns over the UK’s energy policy, climate commitments and continued support for North Sea oil and gas production.

items.title: NEXT WEEK: How AI can accelerate investment in climate solutions
items.summary: With just a week to go, sustainability professionals are invited to register for an upcoming edie webinar exploring how artificial intelligence (AI), market intelligence and human expertise can help businesses identify credible climate investment opportunities and secure the financial backing needed to turn sustainability ambitions into action.

items.title: Jackdaw approval: What is it good for?
items.summary: Following Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh’s approval of the controversial Jackdaw gas project, edie drills into the numbers to see what this means for the UK’s economy, energy security and climate ambitions.

items.title: Win a free VIP pass to edie 27: Take our sustainability snapshot survey
items.summary: Sustainability professionals have the chance to win six months of access to edie’s digital Membership offering as well as a VIP pass to edie 27 in April by completing a short survey.

items.title: Labour says Jackdaw ‘compatible’ with net-zero goal as gas field project is approved
items.summary: Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh has approved the controversial Jackdaw project, in a move that will increase domestic gas production by up to 6%, while also establishing a new low-carbon energy fund based on tax revenues from North Sea projects.

items.title: Prologis UK hits certification milestone with new logistics unit
items.summary: Logistics real estate firm Prologis UK has reached a new milestone for sustainable development, with a new logistics unit at the Daventry International Rail Freight Terminal (DIRFT), becoming its 100th development to achieve Planet Mark certification.
